blocking_findings.summary: Supported Python3.12 full package verification rejects only the intrinsic interpreter path/version field.
blocking_findings.repair: Remove interpreter identity from deterministic control stdout, preserve native provenance separately, regenerate public derivatives, then obtain a new complete review.
